improvements.title: Add Perfetto-compatible redacted evidence trace sidecar
improvements.implementation: Every finalized evidence bundle now emits trace-event.json using Ferrum event names as trace events, monotonic elapsed time as trace timestamps, authoritative evidence wall-clock time as metadata, and the existing redaction path for event arguments.
improvements.proof: Pinned perfetto==0.57.2 independently loaded and queried the generated trace; event type/count parity and monotonic timestamps passed, and the unit regression proves secrets are redacted and caller-forged wallClockAt cannot override the authoritative evidence timestamp.
improvements.agentBenefit: Agents and humans can correlate Ferrum evidence in an established trace ecosystem without losing raw result.json or agent-summary.json evidence.

challengePass.reason: The Perfetto sidecar is already fully proven and merged. Crash capture, isolation, replay and failure-only diagnostics all have credible current candidates, but none has yet completed the required identical-workload real-runtime comparison against Ferrum's current baseline. Adding one now would be speculative dependency or architecture churn.

nextExperiments: Pair ProcDump-for-Linux with rust-minidump on a controlled native crash fixture: retain raw dump/log/PID/build identity, then produce machine-readable stack evidence from that exact artifact.
Run one Ferrum process/API fixture unisolated versus nsjail with no-network/read-only/resource limits and independently prove both parity and restriction enforcement.
Record/replay a deliberately intermittent controlled Linux child failure with rr, measuring record overhead, replay fidelity, evidence size and agent diagnosis value.
Run a bounded failure-only strace experiment before escalating any unresolved Linux diagnostic case to bpftrace.
nextResearchCursor: native-desktop/Tauri/Windows-UIA/mobile-iOS adapters and current agent-control semantic/delta snapshot techniques, unless a crash/isolation experiment produces new evidence first
guardrails: No target, event, artifact, diagnostic, dataset, image/media fidelity, validation or runtime coverage may be reduced to improve speed or simplicity.
Trace and diagnostic sidecars remain additive; result.json, agent-summary.json and raw evidence stay authoritative and available.
Isolation experiments must fail closed when requested and must explicitly prove the real runtime used the requested isolation mechanism.
Crash/replay tools remain optional until real-runtime benefit and bounded overhead are demonstrated.
